items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And Harry was supposed to have been that way too

ctx.x: I was with Irving in Jimmy Dorsey’s band, Irving's a good trumpet player and a wonderful guy and a very funny guy. And Harry was supposed to have been that way too and Freddie the younger brother, it was only Benny, and they said even Benny back in the early days with Pollack was like that too, he became weird later.
I guess success affects different people in different ways.
